Scourgelord's Plate (Tank).bonus_2p: Increases the damage done by your Death and Decay ability by 20%.
Scourgelord's Plate (Tank).bonus_4p: When you activate Blood Tap, you gain 12% damage reduction from all attacks for 10 sec.

Death Knight|Blood Tank.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Shoulder, Chest, Hands, Legs) + Broken Ram Skull Helm (50640) en Head
Death Knight|Blood Tank.guide_quote: The 4-piece Tier 10 bonus turns Blood Tap into a 12% damage reduction cooldown on a 1-minute timer, making it mandatory for progression tanking in Icecrown Citadel.
Death Knight|Blood Tank.approx_value: 12% de reducción de daño activa durante 10s cada 60s (Blood Tap).

Scourgelord's Battlegear (DPS).bonus_2p: Increases the damage done by your Obliterate and Scourge Strike abilities by 10% and the damage done by your Heart Strike ability by 7%.
Scourgelord's Battlegear (DPS).bonus_4p: Whenever all your runes are on cooldown, you gain 3% increased damage done with Weapons, Spells, and Abilities for the next 15 sec.

Death Knight|Frost DPS.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy (50675) en Hands
Death Knight|Frost DPS.guide_quote: Both the 2-piece and 4-piece Tier 10 bonuses are massive upgrades for Frost, as Obliterate is your top damaging ability and the 4-piece 3% damage buff has near 100% uptime.

Death Knight|Unholy DPS.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Scourge Reaver's Legplates (50624) en Legs
Death Knight|Unholy DPS.guide_quote: You will want to use 4-piece Tier 10 as Unholy, dropping the Tier legs for Scourge Reaver's Legplates.

Lasherweave Regalia (Balance).bonus_2p: When you gain Clearcasting from your Omen of Clarity talent, you deal 15% additional Nature and Arcane damage for 6 sec.
Lasherweave Regalia (Balance).bonus_4p: Your critical strikes from Starfire and Wrath cause the target to languish for an additional 7% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

Druid|Balance.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Druid|Balance.guide_quote: Both the 2-piece (Omen of Doom) and 4-piece (Languish) bonuses are essential and provide a massive DPS increase, leaving legs as your off-set piece.
Druid|Balance.approx_value: ~6-7% de DPS total combinado (el 4p Languish aporta ~4.5-5% del daño de Starfire/Wrath).

Lasherweave Battlegear (Feral).bonus_2p: Your Lacerate ability deals 20% additional damage and the cost of your Rip ability is reduced by 10 energy.
Lasherweave Battlegear (Feral).bonus_4p: Your Enrage ability no longer decreases your armor and instead decreases all damage taken by 12%, and the periodic damage dealt by your Rake ability can now be a critical strike.

Druid|Feral DPS.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy (50675) en Hands
Druid|Feral DPS.guide_quote: Allowing Rake periodic ticks to critically strike makes the 4-piece Tier 10 bonus mandatory for Feral DPS.

Druid|Feral Tank.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Hands, Legs) + Ikfirus's Sack of Wonder (50656) en Chest
Druid|Feral Tank.guide_quote: The 4-piece bonus turns Enrage into an extra 12% damage reduction cooldown every minute while removing its armor penalty, making it mandatory for Bear tanks.
Druid|Feral Tank.approx_value: 12% de reducción de daño en Enrage + 20% de daño en Lacerate.

Lasherweave Garb (Restoration).bonus_2p: The healing granted by your Wild Growth spell reduces 30% less over time.
Lasherweave Garb (Restoration).bonus_4p: Each time your Rejuvenation spell heals a target, it has a 2% chance to jump to a new target at full duration.

Druid|Restoration.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Hands, Legs) + Sanguine Silk Robes (50717) en Chest
Druid|Restoration.guide_quote: Both the 2-piece and 4-piece bonuses directly enhance your two strongest spells, Wild Growth and Rejuvenation, making 4-piece Tier 10 mandatory.
Druid|Restoration.approx_value: ~5-7% de incremento de sanación total en banda (HPS).

Ahn'Kahar Blood Hunter's Battlegear.bonus_2p: Your Auto Shots have a 5% chance to cause you and your pet to deal 15% additional damage for 10 sec.
Ahn'Kahar Blood Hunter's Battlegear.bonus_4p: Your Serpent Sting and Wyvern Sting abilities have a 5% chance to grant you 20% attack power for 10 sec each time they deal damage.

Hunter|Beast Mastery.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Leggings of Northern Lights (50645) en Legs
Hunter|Beast Mastery.guide_quote: The 2-piece bonus buffs both you and your pet by 15% damage, making 4-piece Tier 10 with Leggings of Northern Lights the undisputed BiS.

Hunter|Marksmanship.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Leggings of Northern Lights (50645) en Legs
Hunter|Marksmanship.guide_quote: Both Tier 10 set bonuses (Exploit Weakness and Stinger) are massive DPS gains, and you should use 4 pieces with Leggings of Northern Lights as your off-set piece.

Hunter|Survival.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Leggings of Northern Lights (50645) en Legs
Hunter|Survival.guide_quote: 4-piece Tier 10 is mandatory for Survival, dropping the Tier legs for Leggings of Northern Lights.

Bloodmage Regalia.bonus_2p: Your Hot Streak, Missile Barrage, and Brain Freeze talents also grant you 12% spell haste for 5 sec when the effect of the talent is consumed.
Bloodmage Regalia.bonus_4p: Your Mirror Image ability also causes you to deal 18% additional damage for 30 sec.

Mage|Arcane.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Mage|Arcane.guide_quote: The 2-piece (12% haste on Missile Barrage) and 4-piece (18% damage for 30s on Mirror Image) are among the strongest set bonuses in the expansion; always run 4-piece with Plaguebringer's Stained Pants.

Mage|Fire.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Mage|Fire.guide_quote: 4-piece Tier 10 is mandatory for Fire Mage, leaving legs open for Plaguebringer's Stained Pants to cover a massive chunk of your Hit cap.
Mage|Fire.approx_value: ~8-10% de DPS total combinado (2p Pushing the Limit + 4p Quad-Core).

Mage|Frost.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Mage|Frost.guide_quote: Use 4 pieces of Tier 10 with Plaguebringer's Stained Pants as your off-set piece.

Lightsworn Garb (Holy).bonus_2p: While your Divine Illumination talent is active, your healing spells are 35% stronger.
Lightsworn Garb (Holy).bonus_4p: Your Holy Shock spell causes the next Holy Light you cast within 10 sec to have 0.3 sec reduced cast time.

Paladin|Holy.recommended_pieces: 2 piezas (Head y Shoulder) + Chest, Hands y Legs off-set con Haste
Paladin|Holy.guide_quote: The 2-piece Tier 10 bonus is an incredible healing cooldown (+35% healing during Divine Illumination), but the 4-piece bonus is weak and the remaining Tier pieces lack Haste, so you only wear 2 pieces (Helm and Shoulders).
Paladin|Holy.approx_value: +35% de sanación durante 15s cada 3 minutos con el 2p; el 4p se descarta.

Lightsworn Plate (Protection).bonus_2p: Your Hammer of the Righteous ability deals 20% more damage.
Lightsworn Plate (Protection).bonus_4p: When you activate Divine Plea, you gain 12% dodge for 10 sec.

Paladin|Protection.recommended_pieces: 2 piezas (Shoulder y Hands) + Head (50640), Chest (50681) y Legs (50612) off-set con Bonus Armor (o 4p situacional)
Paladin|Protection.guide_quote: For maximum Effective Health (EHP), you only use 2-piece Tier 10 (Shoulders and Hands) alongside the three non-set Bonus Armor pieces (Broken Ram Skull Helm, Blightborne Warplate, and Legguards of Lost Hope).
Paladin|Protection.approx_value: +20% de daño en Hammer of the Righteous (2p).

Lightsworn Battlegear (Retribution).bonus_2p: Your melee attacks have a 40% chance to reset the cooldown on your Divine Storm ability.
Lightsworn Battlegear (Retribution).bonus_4p: Your Seals and Judgements deal 10% additional damage.

Paladin|Retribution.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Fleshrending Gauntlets (50690) o Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy (50675) en Hands
Paladin|Retribution.guide_quote: The 2-piece Tier 10 bonus completely transforms the Retribution rotation with frequent Divine Storm resets and synergizes with Tiny Abomination in a Jar, while the 4-piece adds 10% Seal and Judgement damage; 4-piece is mandatory.

Crimson Acolyte's Regalia (Healer).bonus_2p: Your Flash Heal spell has a 33% chance to cause the target to heal for 33% of the healed amount over 9 sec.
Crimson Acolyte's Regalia (Healer).bonus_4p: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Shield by 5% and Circle of Healing by 10%.

Priest|Discipline.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + San'layn Ritualist Gloves (50722) en Hands
Priest|Discipline.guide_quote: The 4-piece bonus directly increases Power Word: Shield by 5%, which makes up the vast majority of your healing output, making 4-piece Tier 10 mandatory.
Priest|Discipline.approx_value: +5% directo a todas las absorciones de Power Word: Shield (~3.5-4% de HPS total).

Priest|Holy.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Hands, Legs) + Sanguine Silk Robes (50717) en Chest
Priest|Holy.guide_quote: 4-piece Tier 10 is mandatory for Holy Priest to gain the 10% increase on Circle of Healing, using Sanguine Silk Robes as your off-set piece.
Priest|Holy.approx_value: +10% directo a Circle of Healing y +11% promedio en Flash Heal.

Crimson Acolyte's Raiment (Shadow).bonus_2p: The critical strike chance of your Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch spells is increased by 5%.
Crimson Acolyte's Raiment (Shadow).bonus_4p: Reduces the channel duration by 0.5 sec and period by 0.17 sec on your Mind Flay spell.

Priest|Shadow.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Priest|Shadow.guide_quote: The 4-piece Tier 10 bonus is the single biggest upgrade for Shadow Priests in WotLK, reducing Mind Flay's base channel from 3.0s to 2.5s (a 20% effective haste increase on Mind Flay).

Shadowblade's Battlegear.bonus_2p: Gives your Tricks of the Trade ability a 15 energy Return instead of costing energy.
Shadowblade's Battlegear.bonus_4p: Gives your melee finishing moves a 13% chance to add 3 combo points to your target.

Rogue|Assassination.recommended_pieces: 2 piezas (Head y Hands) + Shoulder (50646), Chest (50656) y Legs (50697) off-set
Rogue|Assassination.guide_quote: The 2-piece Tier 10 bonus is mandatory (turning Tricks of the Trade from a 15 energy cost into a 15 energy gain), while using 3 heroic off-set pieces outperforms the 4-piece bonus due to superior Haste/Crit stats.
Rogue|Assassination.approx_value: 2p aporta +30 de energía neta cada 30s (~2.5-3% de DPS).

Rogue|Combat.recommended_pieces: 2 piezas (Head y Shoulder) + Chest (50656), Hands (50675) y Legs (50697) off-set (o 4p antes de tener las 3 piezas 277 off-set)
Rogue|Combat.guide_quote: In full 277 BiS gear, running 2-piece Tier 10 (Helm and Shoulders) with three 277 off-set pieces slightly outperforms 4-piece Tier 10 because it allows reaching the 1400 Armor Penetration cap with superior secondary stats.
Rogue|Combat.approx_value: 2p aporta +30 de energía neta cada 30s; 2p + 3 off-set 277 supera al 4p por ~20-40 DPS en BiS absoluto.

Rogue|Subtlety.guide_quote: Use 2-piece Tier 10 for the Tricks of the Trade energy return and fill the remaining three slots with 277 non-set leather pieces.

Frost Witch's Regalia (Elemental).bonus_2p: Your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells reduce the remaining cooldown on your Elemental Mastery talent by 2 sec.
Frost Witch's Regalia (Elemental).bonus_4p: The cast time of your Lava Burst spell allows your Flame Shock periodic damage ticks to deal damage for at least 6 additional sec.

Shaman|Elemental.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Shaman|Elemental.guide_quote: Both the 2-piece and 4-piece bonuses are huge DPS gains; the 4-piece extends Flame Shock by 6 seconds every time you cast Lava Burst, almost completely removing the need to recast Flame Shock on single target.

Frost Witch's Battlegear (Enhancement).bonus_2p: When you activate your Shamanistic Rage ability you also deal 12% additional damage for 15 sec.
Frost Witch's Battlegear (Enhancement).bonus_4p: Whenever your Maelstrom Weapon talent reaches 5 charges, you have a 15% chance to gain 20% attack power for 10 sec.

Shaman|Enhancement.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Anub'ar Stalker's Gloves (50619) en Hands
Shaman|Enhancement.guide_quote: The 2-piece turns Shamanistic Rage into an offensive 12% damage cooldown every minute and the 4-piece grants a 20% Attack Power buff on 5-stack Maelstrom Weapon procs; 4-piece is mandatory.

Frost Witch's Garb (Restoration).bonus_2p: Your Riptide spell grants 20% spell haste for your next spell cast within 10 sec.
Frost Witch's Garb (Restoration).bonus_4p: Your Chain Heal critical strikes cause the target to heal for 25% of the healed amount over 9 sec.

Shaman|Restoration.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Unclean Surgical Gloves (50703) en Hands
Shaman|Restoration.guide_quote: Both the 2-piece (20% spell haste after Riptide) and 4-piece (25% HoT on Chain Heal crits) are monumental throughput upgrades, making 4-piece Tier 10 mandatory.
Shaman|Restoration.approx_value: ~6-8% de incremento de sanación total en banda (HPS).

Dark Coven's Regalia.bonus_2p: The critical strike chance of your Shadow Bolt, Incinerate, Soul Fire, and Corruption abilities is increased by 5%.
Dark Coven's Regalia.bonus_4p: Each time your Immolate and Unstable Affliction spells deal periodic damage, you have a 15% chance to cause you and your pet to deal 10% additional damage for 10 sec.

Warlock|Affliction.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Warlock|Affliction.guide_quote: 4-piece Tier 10 is mandatory for Affliction; both the 5% Corruption crit from the 2-piece and the 10% damage buff from the 4-piece (Devious Minds) can be snapshotted into Corruption for the entire fight.
Warlock|Affliction.approx_value: ~7-9% de DPS total combinado (incluyendo el snapshot permanente en Corruption).

Warlock|Demonology.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + San'layn Ritualist Gloves (50722) en Hands (o 4p con Legs off-set 50694 si falta Hit)
Warlock|Demonology.guide_quote: 4-piece Tier 10 is mandatory for Demonology, as Devious Minds buffs both you and your Felguard by 10% damage.

Warlock|Destruction.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Hands) + Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en Legs
Warlock|Destruction.guide_quote: Use 4-piece Tier 10 with Plaguebringer's Stained Pants as your off-set piece.

Ymirjar Lord's Battlegear (DPS).bonus_2p: When your Deep Wounds ability deals damage you have a 3% chance to gain 16% attack power for 10 sec.
Ymirjar Lord's Battlegear (DPS).bonus_4p: You have a 20% chance for your Bloodsurge and Sudden Death talents to grant 2 charges of their effect instead of 1, reduces the global cooldown on Execute or Slam by 0.5 sec, and increases the duration of the effect by 100%.

Warrior|Arms.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy (50675) en Hands
Warrior|Arms.guide_quote: Both the 2-piece (16% Attack Power on Deep Wounds ticks) and 4-piece (double Sudden Death charges with a 1.0s Execute GCD) are mandatory for Arms.
Warrior|Arms.approx_value: ~5-7% de DPS total combinado (mayor en combates con cleave por más tics de Deep Wounds).

Warrior|Fury.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Head, Shoulder, Chest, Legs) + Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy (50675) en Hands
Warrior|Fury.guide_quote: You will always use 4-piece Tier 10 as Fury, using leather Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy in the hands slot while replacing the Tier Gauntlets (which have Expertise and Hit beyond what you need).

Ymirjar Lord's Plate (Protection).bonus_2p: Your Shield Slam and Shockwave abilities deal 20% increased damage.
Ymirjar Lord's Plate (Protection).bonus_4p: Your Bloodrage ability no longer costs health to use, and now causes you to absorb damage equal to 20% of your maximum health. Lasts 10 sec.

Warrior|Protection.recommended_pieces: 4 piezas (Shoulder, Chest, Hands, Legs) + Broken Ram Skull Helm (50640) en Head (o 4p con Legguards of Lost Hope 50612 en Legs)
Warrior|Protection.guide_quote: The 2-piece provides a massive boost to your two main threat abilities (Shield Slam and Shockwave) and the 4-piece turns Bloodrage into a 20% max health absorb shield every minute.
Warrior|Protection.approx_value: +20% de daño en Shield Slam/Shockwave (2p) y escudo de absorción del 20% de la salud máxima cada 40-60s (4p).

resumen_calidad.estado_general: MÓDULO 3 COMPLETADO (9 clases, 19 sets de Tier 10, 95 objetos x 3 dificultades = 285 IDs verificados, 31 especialidades cubiertas)
discrepancias_entre_fuentes: Rogue|Combat: Icy Veins y Wowhead coinciden en que con equipo BiS completo de ilvl 277, llevar solo 2 piezas de Tier 10 (Head 51252 y Shoulder 51254) junto con 3 piezas off-set 277 (Ikfirus's Sack of Wonder 50656, Aldriana's Gloves of Secrecy 50675 y Gangrenous Leggings 50697) supera ligeramente al bonus de 4 piezas porque permite alcanzar el hard cap de 1400 de Armor Penetration con mejores estadísticas secundarias; sin embargo, antes de tener las 3 piezas 277 off-set, el 4p T10 es superior.

Paladin|Protection: Ambas fuentes presentan dos configuraciones de Tier 10: 2 piezas (Shoulder + Hands) combinadas con 3 piezas off-set con Bonus Armor (Head 50640, Chest 50681, Legs 50612) para maximizar la armadura y vida efectiva (EHP) contra jefes físicos como el Rey Exánime, o 4 piezas para contar con el proc de 12% de esquiva al activar Divine Plea.

Warlock|Demonology: Si el brujo invierte puntos en Suppression o recibe el 1% de golpe de un Draenei, reemplaza los guantes de Tier por San'layn Ritualist Gloves (50722) manteniendo los pantalones de Tier (que tienen Spirit); si no llega al tope de Hit, usa Plaguebringer's Stained Pants (50694) en piernas y mantiene los guantes de Tier.
especialidades_con_fuente_debil_o_notas: Valor porcentual de los bonus (~X% de DPS/HPS): Ni Icy Veins ni Wowhead publican una tabla numérica estandarizada de porcentaje exacto en todas las páginas de fase 4; en las especialidades donde el análisis textual de la guía explicita el porcentaje aproximado o el efecto directo, se transcribió junto con su explicación.
NO ENCONTRADO: Ningún ID ni texto de bonus quedó como NO ENCONTRADO.
